MONGO_APP_USER.description: Application user created by scripts/mongo-init.js on first start. Connects from the sharely service.

MONGO_APP_PASSWORD.description: Password for MONGO_APP_USER. Auto-generated on deploy. Sharely service references it via ${{mongo.MONGO_APP_PASSWORD}} in MONGODB_URI.

MONGO_DB_NAME.description: Mongo database name. Both the init script and the sharely service's MONGODB_URI use this.
